grid=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in grid_txt.splitlines()]
from collections import deque
R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if grid[r][c]!=7 and (r,c) not in seen:
   q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
   for x,y in q:
    cells.append((x,y))
    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=nx<R and 0<=ny<C and grid[nx][ny]!=7 and (nx,ny) not in seen:
      seen.add((nx,ny));q.append((nx,ny))
   colors={grid[x][y] for x,y in cells if grid[x][y] not in (0,7,3)}
   comps.append((min(x for x,y in cells),max(x for x,y in cells),min(y for x,y in cells),max(y for x,y in cells),len(cells),colors,cells))
[(a,b,c,d,n,colors) for a,b,c,d,n,colors,cells in sorted(comps)]
